Logical test for well ID format.

Source: R/well.R
is_well_id.Rd

Logical test for well ID format.

Usage

is_well_id(x)

Arguments

x

A string vector.

Value

A logical vector.

Examples

is_well_id(c("a12", "a2", "a02", "foo1"))
#> [1]  TRUE  TRUE  TRUE FALSE
